source: NJ Natural Lands Trust; Mount Olive Public Library (Nov. 2026)

slides.sub: Plus a big town park and a library that lends museum passes. Here are the 3 stops.
slides.source: NJ Natural Lands Trust, Budd Lake Bog Preserve page (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Turkey Brook Park
slides.body: Sports fields, a playground, outdoor workout gear and a dog park. The rec department runs town events here, like the tree lighting.
slides.source: NJ Realtors, Town Feature: Mount Olive Township; NJ Playgrounds, Turkey Brook Park

slides.title: Budd Lake Bog Preserve
slides.meta: Off Sand Shore Rd, Budd Lake
slides.body: A black spruce and tamarack bog at the north end of Budd Lake, the largest naturally formed lake in NJ. The trails are unimproved, so bring boots.
slides.source: NJ Natural Lands Trust, Budd Lake Bog Preserve; Raritan Headwaters, Budd Lake

slides.title: Mount Olive Public Library
slides.body: Got a library card and you're 18 or older? Borrow a free museum pass for 3 days. The list includes the Intrepid and the Morris Museum.
slides.source: Mount Olive Public Library, Museum Passes and About Us pages (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: One Saturday in Mount Olive
slides.tip: Between showings, drive Route 46 past Budd Lake at the time you'd actually leave for work.
slides.source: NJ Natural Lands Trust; Raritan Headwaters; Mount Olive Public Library
